specification.generation_null_seed: When no exact initial claim subset is supplied, only a zero temporal-projection closure certifies generation of no time content. A nonempty projection requires an explicit initial subset.
specification.temporal_projection: Assume all recorded source-claim conditions and auxiliary requirements are available; fire a transfer exactly when every temporal input is reached.
specification.dependency_relation: The union of input-time cross output-time pairs of the transfers, with positive-length transitive closure.
specification.auxiliary_inputs: Preserved table references. The temporal projection grants them; mathematical and physical applicability conditions are fixed by the source audit.
